claims.title: Exact pointwise minimum of the scalar relaxation
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: P_* satisfies S1-S3 and every positive profile satisfying S1-S3 lies pointwise above it.
dependencies: OAI26 scalar assumptions; its h_a recurrence is prior work
claims.limitations: Only the specified scalar relaxation. No actual tensor character realizing P_* is constructed. No priority claim.

claims.title: Compatibility with the rank upper bound
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.limitations: Feasibility at t=3/4 is not a lower bound on the unrestricted matrix multiplication exponent.

claims.title: Compatibility with replication
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: P_*(qa,qb)^3 >= q^4 P_*(a,b)^3 for positive integers q,a,b.
claims.limitations: Does not assert compatibility with every inequality in UZ26.

claims.title: Necessary source length for identical matched sectors
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: A single C(a,B) with three identical C(a,b) targets sharing the a-dimensional input requires B >= 3b+a-1.
claims.limitations: Only the stated identical-sector and single-source class. It does not rule out unequal blocks or tensor-product sources.

claims.title: Product-convolution filtration inequalities
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: The determinant filtration of C(a,b) tensor C(c,d) yields the three stated matched-sector inequality families.
dependencies: OAI26 shared-leg entropy; classical determinant filtration
claims.limitations: Logical independence from the initial scalar system is not proved. No novelty claim for determinant filtration.

claims.title: Uniform tripling gain implies an exponent improvement
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: If every relevant character has a uniform eta>0 gain at all sufficiently large scales, omega <= 9/(4+2 eta).
dependencies: OAI26 spectral conversion and rank bound
claims.limitations: The premise is open. The numerical example 1500/667 is not an established exponent bound.

claims.title: Scalar-profile finite and symbolic checks
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: 73,856 exact grid assertions and four symbolic identities pass.
claims.limitations: The finite grid does not prove the general theorem.

claims.title: Finite product-filtration search
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: 353,664 inequalities over 20,736 source quadruples with a,b,c,d <=12 produce no violation of P_*.
claims.limitations: Historical finite experiment; the all-size question is subsequently settled by AI-FILTRATION-COMPAT-012.

claims.title: Finite monomial-weight searches
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: 12,976 binary, 209,692 ternary, and 20,000 seeded random candidates produce no scored violation.
claims.limitations: Unknown blocks use a slice lower bound. Random candidates need not be distinct. Floating display rankings are not certificates.

claims.title: All-size compatibility of fixed-label determinant filtrations
claims.origin: Codex session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: The matching profile P_* satisfies every fixed-i, fixed-j and fixed-k product-filtration inequality for all positive integer source dimensions. A general concavity and sublinear-boundary theorem proves this.
claims.limitations: Does not cover full direct sums, arbitrary basis changes or oriented characters; does not construct a spectral point. Independently overlaps the stronger equivalence at concurrent commit 73b2d20; not counted as a separate discovery.

claims.title: Affine-line full direct sums of determinant-graded blocks
claims.origin: Codex session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: Explicit integer square weights retain the blocks ri+sj+u=0 as a full direct sum when r,s,r-s are nonzero. Character additivity and Holder yield the corresponding sum-of-t-powers inequality.
dependencies: OAI26 character rules and degeneration monotonicity
claims.limitations: No exponent improvement or historical priority claimed; does not assert arbitrary matched block selections are realizable.

claims.title: Certified whole-block matching upper bounds and actual tensor coefficients
claims.origin: Codex session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: 6561 source quadruples through dimension 9 cover 9600473 relaxed maximal matchings without a matching-profile violation. Four determinant-basis examples check all 4770 coefficients.
claims.limitations: Finite coverage; matching bound drops the output-label restriction and is an upper bound rather than an existence claim. Other branch entropy certificates already cover a larger finite analytic domain.
